note: Parameters of the V4 learner model and planner (services/learner.py, services/planner.py). Modelling choices of this app, not exam facts. Changing a value changes the plan; each is written in docs/v2/metrics.md.

prior.note: smoothing: one error and one correct use are added to every tag

speaking_goals.VERB_FINAL: Ask Zee questions that invite weil, dass or wenn answers, for example 'Warum ...?' and 'Was passiert, wenn ...?'.
speaking_goals.V2_POSITION: Ask Zee questions that invite a time or place first, for example 'Wann ...?' and 'Was machst du morgen?'.
speaking_goals.AUX_HABEN_SEIN: Ask Zee about the past, for example 'Was hast du gestern gemacht?' and 'Wohin bist du am Wochenende gefahren?'.
speaking_goals.PARTIZIP: Ask Zee about the past, for example 'Was hast du gestern gemacht?'.
speaking_goals.CASE_AKK: Ask Zee what he needs, buys or sees, so that he must name objects with an article.
speaking_goals.CASE_DAT: Ask Zee with whom and where, for example 'Mit wem arbeitest du?' and 'Wo wohnst du?'.
speaking_goals.PREP_CASE: Ask Zee where things are and where he goes, so that he must choose a preposition and its case.
speaking_goals.ADJ_ENDING: Ask Zee to describe a thing or a person so that he must put an adjective before a noun.
speaking_goals.SEP_PREFIX: Ask Zee about his daily routine, for example 'Wann stehst du auf?' and 'Was machst du nach der Arbeit?'.
speaking_goals.TENSE_CHOICE: Ask Zee about plans and about what happened, so that he must choose a tense.
speaking_goals.MIDDLE_FIELD_ORDER: Ask Zee for sentences with a time, a place and an object together.

labels.AUX_HABEN_SEIN: haben or sein in the Perfekt
